Line.zh:
是的……我们看到了。

你身负重重，让我们替你卸下一些。

凡你所弃之物，我们皆可携回塘中。
Line.en:
Yes... we see it.

You're carrying so much. Let us lighten your load.

Whatever you no longer want, we can carry back into our pond.

name.zh:
"Yes, brave one..."

The hag smiles at you with her empty eyes.

name.zh: 很好。 我们便将汝之饥饿携走，藏于水底。 它不再啮咬你身，汝腹亦永不复哀鸣。 饥馑之契已立”
name.en: Good. We will take your hunger and keep it beneath the water then. It will no longer gnaw at you. Your belly will never cry again. HUNGER BARGAIN STRUCK
name.ja: Good. We will take your hunger and keep it beneath the water then. It will no longer gnaw at you. Your belly will never cry again. HUNGER BARGAIN STRUCK

name.zh: 很好。我们便将汝之恐惧携走，溺于水底。 群狼视之不过如兔，峭壁望之亦不逾缓丘。 恐惧之契已立
name.en: Good. We will take your fear and drown it in the water then. The wolves will seem no larger than rabbits. The cliffs no steeper than gentle hills. FEAR BARGAIN STRUCK
name.ja: Good. We will take your fear and drown it in the water then. The wolves will seem no larger than rabbits. The cliffs no steeper than gentle hills. FEAR BARGAIN STRUCK

name.zh: 其不愿随我等而去。 善哉。那我们便使其永属汝身——一小簇忠腐，常伴不离。 它将傍汝左右，令诸般贪疾无以寓于汝体。 康健之契已立
name.en: It does not wish to leave with us. Very well. Then we shall make it yours forever. A small and faithful rot. It will linger at your side and keep the hungrier sicknesses from finding a home within you. HEALTH BARGAIN STRUCK
